title: Class 5 Science Olympiad: 50-Question Pattern Mock
description: Practice the published 2026–27 section pattern: 10 Logical Reasoning, 35 Science and 5 Achievers questions, with Achievers carrying 3 marks each. Questions are Kidsplay-authored, not an official SOF paper.

selectionPolicy.notes: Operationalizes the official Level-I 60% current-class / 40% previous-class syllabus rule within the 35-question Science section. This delivery policy does not promote any row to official SOF provenance.
